turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, you must not speak this way. We will see to everything as you wish. You will rest now and look after yourself.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother-in-law, I have prepared everything as you instructed. Please rest assured and take care of yourself.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, I know my time is short. We must ensure the future of our family is secure. I have done my best for them.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest. Father is right, you must take care of yourself. I will see to your wishes as best as I can.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Son, I am glad to see your marriage is arranged. I rest easier knowing you will carry on our family name.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please let the maid take care of you now. I will speak to Father about your wishes.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, my dear, do not worry about our family's future. The eldest son and I will take care of everything. We will ensure your wishes are fulfilled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, eldest son, you must listen. After I am gone, the family's future depends on you. Ensure the maid is cared for as well.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please do not burden yourself with such thoughts. We will take care of everything as you have taught us. Please focus on getting well.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know my time is short. It is not a burden, but a wish to ensure my family is secure. Listen to my words carefully.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, your words are clear and strong. We will marry the maid as you wish and take care of her. Please rest now, knowing we will follow your guidance.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, dear, your words are a beacon of strength for us all. Rest assured, we will marry the maid and care for her as you have cared for us.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, eldest son, take care of my family as I have. Ensure the maid is a part of it, as she has been a part of our lives.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, Father, I will do everything in my power to honor your wishes. The maid will be treated with the respect and love she deserves.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am at peace knowing my family will continue to thrive. Take care of each other.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, my heart is full of peace knowing you will always be with us in spirit. We will honor your wishes and ensure the maid is a cherished part of our family.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, eldest son, see to it that the maid is given the same care and respect as she has shown us. Our family's future depends on unity and love.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I promise to treat the maid with the utmost respect and care, just as you have always taught me. Your family's wishes will be my guiding light.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I trust you both. Now, let us focus on preparing for my passing and ensuring your future is secure.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, fear not. The heavens will smile upon us, and our family will endure. We will honor your memory with every breath we take.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
